sources.label: Argentina Ministry of Health Annual HIV Notifications
sources.description: Argentina Ministry of Health annual HIV notifications, 2014–2023. Each value is the source's explicit national ARG / 200 total for Ambos sexos; province and sex rows are not added. Notifications are not estimates of incident infections, prevalence or AIDS cases. Annual dates denote calendar years, not individual event dates; unknown values stay unknown. CC BY 4.0 is declared by the official resource metadata. The catalogue's older package description differs from the selected 2014–2023 resource. No 2024–2026 observations are supplied by this resource. BEN cumulative notifications remain a separate source and do not enter this curve.
sources.description_zh: 来源：阿根廷国家卫生部，2014–2023 年 HIV 年度通知数。每个数值直接取自来源明确给出的 ARG／200 全国、Ambos sexos 双性别合计行，不累加省份或性别分项。通知数不等于新感染估计、患病存量或 AIDS 病例；年度日期表示自然年，不是个案发生日期，未知值保持未知。官方资源元数据声明 CC BY 4.0；目录包较早的描述与所选 2014–2023 年原件范围不同。该资源尚无 2024–2026 年观测。BEN 累计通知保持独立来源，不混入本曲线。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles de VIH du ministère argentin de la Santé, 2014–2023. Chaque valeur est le total national explicite ARG / 200 pour Ambos sexos ; les provinces et les sexes ne sont pas additionnés. Ces notifications ne mesurent ni les nouvelles infections estimées, ni la prévalence, ni les cas de sida. Les dates désignent des années civiles, pas des dates individuelles ; les valeurs inconnues restent inconnues. Les métadonnées officielles de la ressource déclarent CC BY 4.0. L'ancienne description du catalogue diffère de la ressource 2014–2023 sélectionnée, qui ne fournit aucune observation pour 2024–2026. Les cumuls BEN restent une source séparée, exclue de cette courbe.
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina, Casos notificados de VIH por año y jurisdicción, 2014–2023, national ARG / 200, Ambos sexos. CC BY 4.0. sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods

source_info.primary_label: Santé publique France ODISSÉ annual notifications
source_info.notes: Santé publique France, French Guiana SPF ODISSE Annual Notifications, extracted 2026-11-16. Licence ouverte 2.0, declared by the five source dataset metadata records. Original dataset titles, observed years and URLs accompany source series. Only source-reported all-age/all-type totals enter territory curves; age and serogroup components remain separate. TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Missing territory-years are unknown. Territory observations are not added to France national totals. No publisher endorsement is implied.

source_info.primary_label: Santé publique France ODISSÉ annual notifications
source_info.notes: Santé publique France, Martinique SPF ODISSE Annual Notifications, extracted 2026-11-16. Licence ouverte 2.0, declared by the five source dataset metadata records. Original dataset titles, observed years and URLs accompany source series. Only source-reported all-age/all-type totals enter territory curves; age and serogroup components remain separate. TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Missing territory-years are unknown. Territory observations are not added to France national totals. No publisher endorsement is implied.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。

source_info.primary_label: Santé publique France ODISSÉ annual notifications
source_info.notes: Santé publique France, Martinique SPF ODISSE Annual Notifications, extracted 2026-11-16. Licence ouverte 2.0, declared by the five source dataset metadata records. Original dataset titles, observed years and URLs accompany source series. Only source-reported all-age/all-type totals enter territory curves; age and serogroup components remain separate. TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Missing territory-years are unknown. Territory observations are not added to France national totals. No publisher endorsement is implied.

sources.label: Santé publique France ODISSÉ annual notifications
sources.description: Annual territory notifications published by Santé publique France under Licence ouverte 2.0. GIDS preserves separate age, serogroup and reporting definitions; missing years are unknown. Processing by GIDS does not imply endorsement.
sources.description_zh: 法国公共卫生署按 Licence ouverte 2.0 发布的地区年度疾病报告。GIDS 分别保留年龄、血清型和报告定义；缺失年份保持未知。GIDS 的整理不代表原机构认可或背书。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles territoriales de Santé publique France, sous Licence ouverte 2.0. GIDS conserve séparément les âges, sérogroupes et définitions ; les années absentes restent inconnues. Le traitement par GIDS ne vaut pas approbation de la source.

source_info.notes: No same-structure national weekly open table exists for 2025–2026. Municipality products cover 2007–2022 and 2022–2024; selected BES weekly notifications, BES YTD snapshots, annual microdata and WHO laboratory detections remain independent, with different definitions and calendars.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

source_info.primary_label: Santé publique France ODISSÉ annual notifications
source_info.notes: Santé publique France, Martinique SPF ODISSE Annual Notifications, extracted 2026-11-16. Licence ouverte 2.0, declared by the five source dataset metadata records. Original dataset titles, observed years and URLs accompany source series. Only source-reported all-age/all-type totals enter territory curves; age and serogroup components remain separate. TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Missing territory-years are unknown. Territory observations are not added to France national totals. No publisher endorsement is implied.

sources.label: Santé publique France ODISSÉ annual notifications

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: Brunei Darussalam WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections
sources.description: WHO, Brunei Darussalam WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; country-reported annual indicators, accessed 2026-11-16. Original indicator titles, observed years, values and missing states are retained with each source series. Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. This independent presentation does not imply WHO endorsement. Terms: https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

sources.label: Argentina Ministry of Health Annual HIV Notifications
sources.description: Argentina Ministry of Health annual HIV notifications, 2014–2023. Each value is the source's explicit national ARG / 200 total for Ambos sexos; province and sex rows are not added. Notifications are not estimates of incident infections, prevalence or AIDS cases. Annual dates denote calendar years, not individual event dates; unknown values stay unknown. CC BY 4.0 is declared by the official resource metadata. The catalogue's older package description differs from the selected 2014–2023 resource. No 2024–2026 observations are supplied by this resource. BEN cumulative notifications remain a separate source and do not enter this curve.
sources.description_zh: 来源：阿根廷国家卫生部，2014–2023 年 HIV 年度通知数。每个数值直接取自来源明确给出的 ARG／200 全国、Ambos sexos 双性别合计行，不累加省份或性别分项。通知数不等于新感染估计、患病存量或 AIDS 病例；年度日期表示自然年，不是个案发生日期，未知值保持未知。官方资源元数据声明 CC BY 4.0；目录包较早的描述与所选 2014–2023 年原件范围不同。该资源尚无 2024–2026 年观测。BEN 累计通知保持独立来源，不混入本曲线。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles de VIH du ministère argentin de la Santé, 2014–2023. Chaque valeur est le total national explicite ARG / 200 pour Ambos sexos ; les provinces et les sexes ne sont pas additionnés. Ces notifications ne mesurent ni les nouvelles infections estimées, ni la prévalence, ni les cas de sida. Les dates désignent des années civiles, pas des dates individuelles ; les valeurs inconnues restent inconnues. Les métadonnées officielles de la ressource déclarent CC BY 4.0. L'ancienne description du catalogue diffère de la ressource 2014–2023 sélectionnée, qui ne fournit aucune observation pour 2024–2026. Les cumuls BEN restent une source séparée, exclue de cette courbe.
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina, Casos notificados de VIH por año y jurisdicción, 2014–2023, national ARG / 200, Ambos sexos. CC BY 4.0. Original resource: https://datos.salud.gob.ar/dataset/1f70534d-f5f0-41f7-bc9a-b9809c39a505/resource/747d2078-9d51-40d4-ae59-ced43225459f/download/casos_prov_vih_2014-2023_1.csv. Accessed 2026-11-16. National source totals selected without summing provincial or sex strata.

sources.description: WHO, Brunei Darussalam WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; country-reported annual indicators, accessed 2026-11-16. Original indicator titles, observed years, values and missing states are retained with each source series. Only the 18 reviewed count indicators are eligible; actual categories and available years vary by country. Annual data may lag and do not establish complete national surveillance coverage. WHO dataset terms permit public-health use with attribution; restrictions include commercial promotion, misrepresentation and implied endorsement. This independent presentation does not imply WHO endorsement. Terms: https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/data-policy/terms-and-conditions

sources.license: WHO dataset terms for public health use
sources.required_attribution: World Health Organization (WHO), Brunei Darussalam WHO GHO Annual Reported Infections; underlying data reported by Brunei Darussalam. Original indicator titles and observed years accompany each source series. Accessed 2026-11-16.

sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

sources.description: ISO-week respiratory diagnosis counts. Hospitalizations, samples, and vaccination indicators are separate measures and are not counted as diagnoses.

sources.description: Historical official registry tables for 1997–2021, with annual totals and disease-specific monthly notification facts retained at source grain.

sources.description: Historical Saga EHR ICD encounter counts for 1997–2020. This clinical measure is non-comparable with registry notifications and is kept separate.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: WHO FluNet Colombia weekly laboratory detections

source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Chile WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: World Health Organization, Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System
sources.required_attribution: World Health Organization, Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System. Chile WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance. Original source: https://www.who.int/tools/flunet. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

source_info.notes: No same-structure national weekly open table exists for 2025–2026. Municipality products cover 2007–2022 and 2022–2024; selected BES weekly notifications, BES YTD snapshots, annual microdata and WHO laboratory detections remain independent, with different definitions and calendars.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: WHO FluNet Colombia weekly laboratory detections
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory detections; sentinel and nonsentinel retained separately, not national incident patient cases.
sources.label_zh: WHO FluNet 哥伦比亚实验室周检出数
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室每周检出数；哨点与非哨点分别展示，不能解释为全国新发病例。

source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Czechia SZÚ Monthly Notifications

sources.description_zh: 按原表明确的报告周或月份展示全国新增报告数；累计数、人口分层与年度历史分别保留。缺失单元格保持未知。
sources.publisher: Státní zdravotní ústav (SZÚ)
sources.required_attribution: Státní zdravotní ústav (SZÚ). Czechia SZÚ Monthly Notifications. Original source: https://szu.gov.cz/publikace-szu/data/infekce-v-cr/. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Czechia ECDC Weekly Respiratory Surveillance
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
sources.required_attribution: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC). Czechia ECDC Weekly Respiratory Surveillance. Original source: https://github.com/EU-ECDC/Respiratory_viruses_weekly_data. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Czechia Annual Baseline
sources.description: Czechia annual Member-State reported case counts from the ECDC Surveillance Atlas. Missing topic/year cells remain unknown and published zeroes are preserved. Data provided by ECDC based on data reported by EU/EEA Member States.

source_info.notes: Only directly reported national single-week case totals from reviewed summary tables and explicit bulletin dates are presented. Classification components, cumulative and comparison columns are not summed; unreadable or missing source values stay unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.

sources.label: Peru CDC Epidemiological Bulletin
sources.description: Only directly reported national single-week case totals from reviewed summary tables and explicit bulletin dates are presented. Classification components, cumulative and comparison columns are not summed; unreadable or missing source values stay unknown. Missing values remain unknown and explicit source zeros are preserved. An open license covering these data has not been verified; third-party reuse should consult the original source terms.
sources.description_zh: 仅展示已审核汇总表直接列出的全国单周病例总数，采用周报明确日期；分类分项、累计列和对比列不相加，无法读取或缺失的来源数值保持未知。 缺失值保持未知，来源明确的零值予以保留。尚未核实覆盖此数据的开放许可；第三方复用请查阅原始来源条款。
sources.description_fr: Seuls les totaux nationaux hebdomadaires directement publiés dans les tableaux récapitulatifs examinés, avec dates explicites, sont présentés. Composantes, cumuls et comparaisons ne sont pas additionnés ; valeurs illisibles ou absentes restent inconnues. Les valeurs manquantes restent inconnues et les zéros explicites sont conservés. Aucune licence ouverte couvrant ces données n’a été vérifiée ; consulter les conditions de la source avant toute réutilisation par des tiers.
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud del Perú, CDC Perú / DGE
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud del Perú, CDC Perú / DGE, Peru CDC Epidemiological Bulletin. Original source: https://www.dge.gob.pe/portalnuevo/informacion-publica/boletines-epidemiologicos/. Source definitions and reporting periods retained.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.

sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Missing territory-years are unknown. Territory observations are not added to France national totals. No publisher endorsement is implied.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

source_info.primary_label: Canada PHAC Weekly Respiratory Virus Detections
source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Canada PHAC Weekly Respiratory Virus Detections
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
sources.required_attribution: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC). Canada PHAC Weekly Respiratory Virus Detections. Original source: https://health-infobase.canada.ca/respiratory-virus-surveillance/. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Canada PHAC CNDSS Annual
sources.description: Canadian national annual reported disease counts assembled by PHAC from voluntary provincial and territorial CNDSS submissions. A published national aggregate does not mean every jurisdiction is complete: official disease-specific inclusion tables vary by year. The October 2024 extract no longer marks 44 disease contracts as Manitoba-2023-unavailable. Null cells remain unknown and explicit zeroes are preserved.

source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Czechia SZÚ Monthly Notifications
sources.description: Source-published national incident notifications for the explicit reporting week or month. Cumulative totals, demographic strata and annual history remain separate. Missing cells remain unknown.
sources.description_zh: 按原表明确的报告周或月份展示全国新增报告数；累计数、人口分层与年度历史分别保留。缺失单元格保持未知。
sources.publisher: Státní zdravotní ústav (SZÚ)
sources.required_attribution: Státní zdravotní ústav (SZÚ). Czechia SZÚ Monthly Notifications. Original source: https://szu.gov.cz/publikace-szu/data/infekce-v-cr/. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Czechia ECDC Weekly Respiratory Surveillance
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
sources.required_attribution: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC). Czechia ECDC Weekly Respiratory Surveillance. Original source: https://github.com/EU-ECDC/Respiratory_viruses_weekly_data. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Czechia Annual Baseline
sources.description: Czechia annual Member-State reported case counts from the ECDC Surveillance Atlas. Missing topic/year cells remain unknown and published zeroes are preserved. Data provided by ECDC based on data reported by EU/EEA Member States.

source_info.notes: HPSC data are published by operator decision without confirmed written permission; HPSC terms require prior permission. Archive reuse rights have not been verified. ECDC annual data are attributed separately.

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
sources.description: HPSC weekly notification data. Published by operator decision; written reuse permission has not been confirmed. HPSC terms require prior permission.

source_info.primary_label: Canada PHAC Weekly Respiratory Virus Detections
source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Canada PHAC Weekly Respiratory Virus Detections
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
sources.required_attribution: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC). Canada PHAC Weekly Respiratory Virus Detections. Original source: https://health-infobase.canada.ca/respiratory-virus-surveillance/. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Canada PHAC CNDSS Annual
sources.description: Canadian national annual reported disease counts assembled by PHAC from voluntary provincial and territorial CNDSS submissions. A published national aggregate does not mean every jurisdiction is complete: official disease-specific inclusion tables vary by year. The October 2024 extract no longer marks 44 disease contracts as Manitoba-2023-unavailable. Null cells remain unknown and explicit zeroes are preserved.

source_info.primary_label: Chile WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance
source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Chile WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: World Health Organization, Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System
sources.required_attribution: World Health Organization, Global Influenza Surveillance and Response System. Chile WHO FluNet Weekly Respiratory Laboratory Surveillance. Original source: https://www.who.int/tools/flunet. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

source_info.notes: High-frequency source measures and annual notification history are retained independently; overlapping networks, periods and strata are not additive.

sources.label: Czechia SZÚ Monthly Notifications
sources.description: Source-published national incident notifications for the explicit reporting week or month. Cumulative totals, demographic strata and annual history remain separate. Missing cells remain unknown.
sources.description_zh: 按原表明确的报告周或月份展示全国新增报告数；累计数、人口分层与年度历史分别保留。缺失单元格保持未知。
sources.publisher: Státní zdravotní ústav (SZÚ)
sources.required_attribution: Státní zdravotní ústav (SZÚ). Czechia SZÚ Monthly Notifications. Original source: https://szu.gov.cz/publikace-szu/data/infekce-v-cr/. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: Czechia ECDC Weekly Respiratory Surveillance
sources.description: Weekly respiratory laboratory surveillance. Detections, tests and positivity are separate measures; reporting networks, origins and subtypes overlap and must not be added or interpreted as national incident patient cases.
sources.description_zh: 呼吸道实验室周监测。检出数、检测数及阳性率分别展示，报告网络、来源和亚型可能重叠，不累加、不解释为全国新增患者数。
sources.publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
sources.required_attribution: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC). Czechia ECDC Weekly Respiratory Surveillance. Original source: https://github.com/EU-ECDC/Respiratory_viruses_weekly_data. Source definitions, strata and periods retained.

sources.label: ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Czechia Annual Baseline

source_info.primary_label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
source_info.notes: HPSC data are published by operator decision without confirmed written permission; HPSC terms require prior permission. Archive reuse rights have not been verified. ECDC annual data are attributed separately.

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
sources.description: HPSC weekly notification data. Published by operator decision; written reuse permission has not been confirmed. HPSC terms require prior permission.
sources.description_zh: 爱尔兰 HPSC 每周法定传染病数据。根据网站运营者决定公开；尚未确认取得书面再利用许可，HPSC 条款要求事先取得许可。

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Weekly Report Archive
sources.description: Sparse historical weekly reports; missing reports are not zero. Published by operator decision; archive reuse rights have not been verified.

sources.description_fr: Rapports hebdomadaires historiques incomplets ; une absence ne signifie pas zéro. Publiés sur décision de l’exploitant ; les droits de réutilisation des archives n’ont pas été vérifiés.

sources.label: Ireland HPSC Annual Infectious Disease Statistics
sources.description: HPSC historical annual statistics, published by operator decision; written reuse permission has not been confirmed.
sources.description_zh: 爱尔兰 HPSC 历年年度统计，根据网站运营者决定公开；尚未确认取得书面再利用许可。
sources.description_fr: Statistiques annuelles historiques du HPSC publiées sur décision de l’exploitant ; l’autorisation écrite de réutilisation n’a pas été confirmée.

sources.label: ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Ireland Annual Baseline
sources.description: Ireland annual Member-State reported case counts from the ECDC Surveillance Atlas. Missing topic/year cells remain unknown and published zeroes are preserved. Data provided by ECDC based on data reported by EU/EEA Member States.

sources.label: Argentina Ministry of Health Annual HIV Notifications
sources.description: Argentina Ministry of Health annual HIV notifications, 2014–2023. Each value is the source's explicit national ARG / 200 total for Ambos sexos; province and sex rows are not added. Notifications are not estimates of incident infections, prevalence or AIDS cases. Annual dates denote calendar years, not individual event dates; unknown values stay unknown. CC BY 4.0 is declared by the official resource metadata. The catalogue's older package description differs from the selected 2014–2023 resource. No 2024–2026 observations are supplied by this resource. BEN cumulative notifications remain a separate source and do not enter this curve.
sources.description_zh: 来源：阿根廷国家卫生部，2014–2023 年 HIV 年度通知数。每个数值直接取自来源明确给出的 ARG／200 全国、Ambos sexos 双性别合计行，不累加省份或性别分项。通知数不等于新感染估计、患病存量或 AIDS 病例；年度日期表示自然年，不是个案发生日期，未知值保持未知。官方资源元数据声明 CC BY 4.0；目录包较早的描述与所选 2014–2023 年原件范围不同。该资源尚无 2024–2026 年观测。BEN 累计通知保持独立来源，不混入本曲线。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles de VIH du ministère argentin de la Santé, 2014–2023. Chaque valeur est le total national explicite ARG / 200 pour Ambos sexos ; les provinces et les sexes ne sont pas additionnés. Ces notifications ne mesurent ni les nouvelles infections estimées, ni la prévalence, ni les cas de sida. Les dates désignent des années civiles, pas des dates individuelles ; les valeurs inconnues restent inconnues. Les métadonnées officielles de la ressource déclarent CC BY 4.0. L'ancienne description du catalogue diffère de la ressource 2014–2023 sélectionnée, qui ne fournit aucune observation pour 2024–2026. Les cumuls BEN restent une source séparée, exclue de cette courbe.
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina, Casos notificados de VIH por año y jurisdicción, 2014–2023, national ARG / 200, Ambos sexos. CC BY 4.0. Original resource: https://datos.salud.gob.ar/dataset/1f70534d-f5f0-41f7-bc9a-b9809c39a505/resource/747d2078-9d51-40d4-ae59-ced43225459f/download/casos_prov_vih_2014-2023_1.csv. Accessed 2026-11-16. National source totals selected without summing provincial or sex strata.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

source_info.notes: No same-structure national weekly open table exists for 2025–2026. Municipality products cover 2007–2022 and 2022–2024; selected BES weekly notifications, BES YTD snapshots, annual microdata and WHO laboratory detections remain independent, with different definitions and calendars.

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA municipality records (2007–2022)
sources.description: Historical municipality-of-occurrence event/week counts, 2007–2022. These are not an official national weekly table. National aggregation and dated week boundaries require separate validation.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 市镇周汇总（2007–2022）
sources.description_zh: 2007–2022 年按发生地市镇、事件及周汇总的数据，并非官方全国周表。全国加总及周历边界须另行核验。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA successor municipality records (2022–2024)
sources.description: Separate successor open table covering 2022–2024; ingestion uses 2023–2024 and excludes the 2022 overlap. No 2025 or 2026 rows were present in the checked release. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation coverage.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 后续市镇周汇总（2022–2024）
sources.description_zh: 独立的后续开放表，实际覆盖 2022–2024 年；采集采用 2023–2024 年并排除重复的 2022 年。已检查版本没有 2025 或 2026 年数据，元数据更新时间不代表数据覆盖至今。

sources.label: INS SIVIGILA annual microdata (through 2025)
sources.description: Annual workbooks through 2025; no 2026 workbook in the checked catalogue. Weekly aggregates derived from individual records retain source case classifications and foreign/unknown occurrence separately. Collective forms require event-specific measures. Derived notification counts are not a published INS national incidence table.
sources.label_zh: INS SIVIGILA 年度微观数据（截至 2025）
sources.description_zh: 按统计年度发布的工作簿，已检查目录截至 2025 年，没有 2026 年表。个案按原始年周聚合，保留病例分类及境外、未知发生地；集体表须按事件核验指标。这是个案衍生的通知记录数，并非 INS 发布的全国周发病表。

sources.label: INS BES weekly bulletins (cumulative annex and weekly evidence)
sources.description: Reviewed body-table weekly notifications only. Annex year-to-date snapshots are separate and never weekly incidence; early issues without an explicit weekly definition remain gaps.
sources.label_zh: INS BES 周报（累计附录与当周证据）
sources.description_zh: 仅展示正文中明确单周定义的通知数。附录 Acumulado 累计数单独保存，不作周发病数；早期缺少明确周定义的报告保持缺口。

sources.label: INS event reports and surveillance methods
sources.description: Event-specific annual and epidemiological-period reports supply definitions and reconciliation evidence. They do not provide a complete multi-disease national weekly table and are not merged automatically.
sources.label_zh: INS 单事件报告与监测方法
sources.description_zh: 按事件发布的年报及流行病学周期报告，用于核对病例定义、统计口径及总数，并非完整的全病种全国周表，不自动拼接为周曲线。

sources.label: Argentina Ministry of Health Annual HIV Notifications
sources.description: Argentina Ministry of Health annual HIV notifications, 2014–2023. Each value is the source's explicit national ARG / 200 total for Ambos sexos; province and sex rows are not added. Notifications are not estimates of incident infections, prevalence or AIDS cases. Annual dates denote calendar years, not individual event dates; unknown values stay unknown. CC BY 4.0 is declared by the official resource metadata. The catalogue's older package description differs from the selected 2014–2023 resource. No 2024–2026 observations are supplied by this resource. BEN cumulative notifications remain a separate source and do not enter this curve.
sources.description_zh: 来源：阿根廷国家卫生部，2014–2023 年 HIV 年度通知数。每个数值直接取自来源明确给出的 ARG／200 全国、Ambos sexos 双性别合计行，不累加省份或性别分项。通知数不等于新感染估计、患病存量或 AIDS 病例；年度日期表示自然年，不是个案发生日期，未知值保持未知。官方资源元数据声明 CC BY 4.0；目录包较早的描述与所选 2014–2023 年原件范围不同。该资源尚无 2024–2026 年观测。BEN 累计通知保持独立来源，不混入本曲线。
sources.description_fr: Notifications annuelles de VIH du ministère argentin de la Santé, 2014–2023. Chaque valeur est le total national explicite ARG / 200 pour Ambos sexos ; les provinces et les sexes ne sont pas additionnés. Ces notifications ne mesurent ni les nouvelles infections estimées, ni la prévalence, ni les cas de sida. Les dates désignent des années civiles, pas des dates individuelles ; les valeurs inconnues restent inconnues. Les métadonnées officielles de la ressource déclarent CC BY 4.0. L'ancienne description du catalogue diffère de la ressource 2014–2023 sélectionnée, qui ne fournit aucune observation pour 2024–2026. Les cumuls BEN restent une source séparée, exclue de cette courbe.
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina, Casos notificados de VIH por año y jurisdicción, 2014–2023, national ARG / 200, Ambos sexos. CC BY 4.0. Original resource: https://datos.salud.gob.ar/dataset/1f70534d-f5f0-41f7-bc9a-b9809c39a505/resource/747d2078-9d51-40d4-ae59-ced43225459f/download/casos_prov_vih_2014-2023_1.csv. Accessed 2026-11-16. National source totals selected without summing provincial or sex strata.

sources.label: Chile MINSAL Historical ENO Notifications
sources.description: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16. The official CKAN catalogue declares CC0. Only reviewed confirmed national annual notification aggregates are presented; individual case rows are not released. The current CSV covers 2007–2024 and a changed disease inventory, while the catalogue text and methodology PDF still describe 2007–2022 and older exclusions. This upstream discrepancy is retained in the source audit; the older PDF is not asserted to describe the current CSV. Notification year is not onset year. Source-system periods and classifications remain separate; absent disease-years are unknown.
sources.description_zh: 来源：智利卫生部，Notificaciones ENO；访问日期：2026-11-16。官方CKAN目录声明CC0。仅展示已审核的全国确诊年度通知汇总，不公开个案记录。当前CSV覆盖2007–2024年并含变化后的病种目录，而目录文字和方法PDF仍描述2007–2022年及旧排除范围；该上游差异保留审计，不将旧PDF视为当前CSV的完整说明。通知年份不等于发病年份，源系统时期和分类分别保留，缺失病种年份保持未知。
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Salud de Chile
sources.required_attribution: Ministerio de Salud de Chile, Notificaciones ENO, accessed 2026-11-16; national confirmed annual aggregates derived from the captured CSV, 2007–2024.

source_info.notes: Iceland Directorate of Health annual, monthly STI, weekly respiratory and historical Excel surveillance. Source series retain reporting basis and temporal grain separately.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Annual Dashboard
sources.description: National annual case notifications by disease. Published values can be revised retrospectively and remain annual period totals.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health STI Dashboard
sources.description: Monthly STI diagnosis facts from laboratory and registry surveillance; the official dashboard is published on a quarterly schedule.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Respiratory Dashboard
sources.description: ISO-week respiratory diagnosis counts. Hospitalizations, samples, and vaccination indicators are separate measures and are not counted as diagnoses.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Historical Registry
sources.description: Historical official registry tables for 1997–2021, with annual totals and disease-specific monthly notification facts retained at source grain.

sources.label: Iceland Directorate of Health Legacy ICD Monthly
sources.description: Historical Saga EHR ICD encounter counts for 1997–2020. This clinical measure is non-comparable with registry notifications and is kept separate.
